newsitem.title: GERMANY: MAX Holding plans U.S. purchases, listing.
newsitem.headline: MAX Holding plans U.S. purchases, listing.

text.p: German industrial holding company M.A.X. Holding AG said on Tuesday that it planned to buy a U.S. company in 1997 and to seek a listing in the United States.
Both steps would be examined over the coming year, executive board member Friedrich Holtkoetter said in an ad-hoc statement.
The group said that it planned growth of four percent in the current year, which would not include new acquisitions, of which two were definitely in the pipeline.
Consolidated sales in 1996 rose to 300 million marks, up 43 percent on 1995, while group net profits were 16 million marks.
The group went on to say that it plans to issue a convertible participation certificate in March of this year. This is a kind of qualified dividend instrument or certificate of beneficial interest.
